Hive (S14) (www.hive.co) | Engineering roles | Remote within Canada | Full-time

We power marketing for 1,500+ live event brands across North America — festivals, venues, promoters, tours. 40M+ emails and SMS a month, billions of customer data points, real-time integrations with Ticketmaster, Eventbrite, Shopify, and 20+ others.

We’re hiring across a few of our pods:

Senior Product Software Developer, Frontend / Fullstack (3+ yrs) Ship customer-facing features end-to-end. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hive.co/19c52872-49b4-4095-b0d6-e75...

Engineering Manager, Platform & Services (3+ yrs managing · 5+ yrs hands-on) Lead our platform, infrastructure, and integration pods. Coach the team, set the bar, and help shape engineering-wide direction as part of the eng leadership team. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hive.co/cc0790ff-b693-4e3f-8dba-31d...

Head of Product (AI SaaS · PM, Design & PMM Leadership) Lead Product, Design, and Product Marketing as one customer-obsessed team. Build the operating rhythms, roadmap process, and feedback loops that turn strategy into shipped product.
